name: Kojima Takashi
source:
The leader of the trio comprised of Nae, Hachi and himself.
Despite Yuuta being a transfer student, he welcomed him heartfully.
While he is by no means an honor student, he can truly be called a healthy, wholesome young boy.
He has a younger brother four years his junior.

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
